prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on the facts of your case and what you need (catastrophic injuries vs. minor injuries, desire to try the case in court, budget, etc.). I can help you find a lawyer; to do that it helps if you tell me a few details (where in Houston the wreck occurred, how severe the injuries are, whether anyone was hospitalized, and whether you already have an insurer/claims number).

Useful immediate information and next steps
- Time limit: In Texas you generally have 2 years from the wreck date to file a personal injury suit. Don’t wait too long.
- Preserve evidence: keep photos, repair estimates, medical records, bills, wage-loss documentation, the police report, and witness contact info.
- Don’t give recorded statements to the other insurer or sign anything without talking to an attorney.
- Get medical care and follow providers’ instructions (important both for health and for your claim).

How to pick the best lawyer for your situation
- Relevant experience: look for lawyers who focus on car-accident and personal-injury cases (not generalists).
- Trial experience: firms that actually try cases often get stronger settlement offers.
- Track record: ask about past verdicts/settlements for similar injuries.
- Resources: big claims may need investigators, medical experts, accident reconstructionists — make sure the firm has those resources.
- Fees and costs: most work on contingency (no fee unless you recover) — confirm percentage, who advances expenses, and how costs are handled if you lose.
- Communication and accessibility: ask how you’ll be updated and who you’ll talk to day-to-day.
- Conflicts and license: check Texas Bar standing and reviews (State Bar of Texas, AVVO, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Google/Yelp).

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled?
- What results have you achieved for similar injuries?
- Do you try cases or mostly settle?
- What is your contingency fee and who pays case expenses upfront?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your estimated timeline and likely value range?
- Can you provide references from past clients?

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of well-rated Houston personal injury attorneys/firms (I’ll ask about your ZIP or neighborhood to match proximity and scope).
- Draft a short message or list of questions you can send to attorneys when contacting them.
Tell me which you prefer and give the ZIP/neighborhood or a one-line summary of the crash/injuries, and I’ll pull together tailored recommendations and a ready-to-use consultation checklist.
